balls.text: Venkatesh is on the floor, and so is the middle stump. Another Bumrah special. Venkatesh, having shuffled across the stumps, was looking to flip it over the keeper but loses his balance. Bumrah has the stumps splayed once again. Un-hittable stuff from Bumrah
low full-toss outside off, carved to the off-side sweeper. Venkatesh denies the single on offer
low full-toss on middle, stabbed down to long-off. Venkatesh scampers back for the double
good length and angling across off, seems like an on-pace delivery once again. Venkatesh swings so hard that he loses his shape and misses it altogether
wide yorker, angling across off stump, Venkatesh jabs his bat down in the nick of time and keeps it out
slowie, much fuller and outside off, better length from Thushara. Venkatesh opens the bat-face and dinks it through point
reversed over short third for four more. Full and outside off, Venkatesh anticipated this line from Thushara once again. He flips it over short third

hoicked over the leg side for a much-needed six for KKR. Another slower ball, into the pitch, pushed across off stump. Venkatesh holds his shape for long enough and puts it away. The ball hits the ad cushion on the full. Six indeed
full and floated across off, slower variation from Thushara. Venkatesh reverse-sweeps early and does not touch the ball
slowie. Short and wide of off, slapped away to the right of extra-cover
overpitched and outside off, Venkatesh can't put it away. He finds point
full and slings it too wide of off. Off-side wide
Starc can't keep this out. Another inswinging yorker from Bumrah. Jags back in from round the stumps and storms through the defences of Starc. Starc has his stumps splayed by an inch-perfect yorker
yorker, tails in at the base of off stump from round the wicket, Starc somehow keeps it out

ramped straight into the lap of Coetzee at deep third. On-pace short ball outside off, Ramandeep leans back and hits it in the air. Coetzee, for a brief moment lost the ball in the lights, but eventually slides on his knees to take it with both hands
slower short ball outside off, Ramandeep can't ramp it away. Beaten
just misses the yorker, comes out as a full-toss, which is stroked to midwicket
rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and dinks it to deep third

A horrible mix-up between the wickets and Russell has to go. Russell almost ran two like Daz Mitchell had done at Chepauk. He's caught short at the non-striker's end. The single was on but Venkatesh was simply ball-watching and KKR have to pay the penalty with the wicket of Russell. Venkatesh jumps across the stumps and reverse-sweeps it just wide of short third. The throw from Thushara to Hardik is fairly accurate, and the MI captain does the rest

Venkatesh backs away outside leg, Pandya tries to follow the moving batter with an on-pace yorker but misses his length. Venkatesh gets underneath the length and tonks it over wide long-on for six more
keeps it slow and on a wide line, swatted down to long-off by Russell
Russell begins with a first-ball six. Dug in short and wide of off, Russell stays leg-side of the ball and ramps itover deep third

Pandey holes out. 121.2ks cutter on a wide line with six men on the off side. Pandey loses his shape while reaching out for this wide delivery. He skies it and it's taken by the extra-cover fielder (Brevis, the sub) running to his right
Hardik pushes it too wide of off. He has to re-bowl it
tonked over long-on for six. Slower ball from Hardik, but the length is a bit too full although the line is wide of off. Pandey reaches out for the ball and smacks it over the outfielder
another slowie from Thushara. Short, into the pitch, angling away outside off from over the wicket as Venkatesh slogs and misses
another slowie outside off. Venkatesh does not pick it. He charges early, swings and misses
yorker on middle, Pandey stays deep in the crease for this very length. Hacked out to deep midwicket
wide yorker, dug out through point. Just a single
slowie, short and wide. Thushara hides this free-hit away from the reach of Pandey. Mis-hit in front of long-off
Thushara searches for a yorker, comes out a beamer on leg stump. Pandey manages to duck out of the way
very full and slings it wide of off, sliced away to the off-side sweeper. Venkatesh raises a half-century and gives the thumbs-up to the KKR dugout. Pandit is up on his feet to applaud the effort
acceptable yorker on leg stump, squeezed away to deep midwicket
short, slow and into the pitch, dragged away to deep midwicket
short and wide of off, Pandey stays leg-side of the ball and flat-bats this slowie down to long-off
dug in short and outside off, zips off the surface, Pandey shapes for another ramp but doesn't lay bat on ball this time
pretty full on middle and leg, struck to long-on
back of a length and on middle and leg, swiped away to wide long-on. Venkatesh and Pandey hare back for the double
full-toss, angling into the stumps at 141.6ks, but it's still a hard-to-hit full-toss. Plinked to midwicket
very full and on off, 142.2ks, Venkatesh still can't get underneath it. Jabbed down to mid-off for a single
seems like a slower ball outside off. Pandey dabs it to point
ramped fine of deep third for six! Pandey sizes it up this short ball outside off, leans back, and lifts it over the 'V' behind the wicket for six
Pandey stays leg-side of this short ball outside off and punches it to extra-cover
back of a length and slanting down the leg side, deflected away fine past a diving keeper. Given as four runs. Replays indicate that it went off the thigh pad
Pandey stays deep in the crease and whips a full-toss out to deep midwicket
back of a length and on the hips, whipped away to deep midwicket on the back foot
just short of a good length and on top of off, forced down to mid-off
slower cutter wide of off, thrashed to deep cover
Pandey charges at Hardik but he loses his line. Floats this slower ball wide of off. Is this an off-side wide? MI review it and it's a legal ball in the end
seems like a slower delivery on off, Pandey delays his push and strokes it to extra-cover
Carted over extra-cover for six. Venkatesh manufactures swinging room and dashes out of the crease. Uses his heads to reach this delivery on a wide line and pumps it over the off side
full and on the stumps, Pandey opts to hang back and punch it down to long-on
mighty full and outside off, not quite a yorker, Venkatesh stays leg-side of the ball and stabs it to mid-off
low full-toss outside off, Venkatesh stays leg-side of the ball and forces it to backward point, where Tilak throws himself to his left to stop the ball
hip-high short ball outside off, Venkatesh sizes it up and swats a pull over midwicket, well wide of deep square
on a length and on the stumps, punched past the bowler for a single
tapped down the ground for another single
SKY makes a sprawling save at long-off! Excellent work in the outfield, sliding to his left. Down the track and drilled down the ground
pushed through flat and quick outside off, chopped on the back foot to point
dropped short and wide of off, chopped on the back foot to point
wrong line from Chawla. He slides it down the leg side, glanced away fine for four
whipped down to long-on
tossed up and outside off, guided down to long-off
tossed up on middle, eased down to long-on
sliced just wide of short third off a thick outside edge
clipped away through the vacant spaces at midwicket for a hard-run double
tossed up and turning into off stump, tapped down to long-on on the front foot
lobbed up slow and wide of off, but it's too wide. Dhir has to re-bowl it
half-tracker, speared short and wide of off. Pandey latches onto it and crunnnnnnnnnches it away through extra-cover
tossed up on middle and sticks in the surface, knocked away to Chawla's right
slower through the air and dips at off stump, Pandey delays his push and plays it back to the bowler
Venkatesh uses his feet and works the ball away through midwicket
fractionally short and outside off, Venkatesh jumps onto the back foot and slashes to backward point
chopped through point
chipped in the air but away from the outstretched left hand of Chawla
clipped through midwicket
chopped to short third man
jabbed through mid-on
Pandey stretches out and drives through the covers
tucked off the pads through square leg
back of a length and turning into the top of off, forced down to long-on
hard-spun legbreak from Chawla, Ventakesh slogs and ekes out an inside edge onto the pad
whipped away in the gap between deep midwicket and wide long-on this time
Venkatesh aims for the leg side but ends up stabbing it back to the bowler
pushed through outside off, stroked back to the bowler
whisked into the covers

KKR are five down and sinking in seven overs. Rinku has chipped it straight back to Chawla. No mistake from Chawla this time. Slower through the air, turning in against the angle from over the wicket. Doesn't come onto the bat. Rinku closes the bat face early and chips a leading edge back to the bowler
tapped into the covers
slog-swept from outside off to the square-leg boundary. Venkatesh stretches out and drags it away past Chawla at square leg, who fumbles and gives up four
clipped away through the midwicket region
dangled up and breaks away outside off, sliced in front of point
tossed up on middle, slower through the air, Rinku checks his drive and chips it in front of Dhir
jabbed to midwicket for a single
pitched-up delivery wide of off, from round the stumps, Rinku has a crack at it and carves it over backward point for four more
short and outside off from round the stumps, Rinku sways his upper body out of the way
fuller than a good length and veering down the leg side, Rinku tickles it away fine for a second-ball four
good length and on off stump, blocked on the front foot

Narine swings again, this time he misses, and Hardik hits the leg stump. The length was there to be hit, but Narine swings so very hard that he loses his shape and doesn't touch it at all. KKR four down inside five overs
Launched over square leg for six. Banged short and into the pitch. Narine stays back, swivels on the back foot and pulls it away. He was waiting for this length?
good length ball on off stump, he's cramped as he defends it
smoothly struck through cover. Too full. With width on offer. Too easy even for a new batter. Iyer simply leans into the drive and makes sure to pick the gap
looks to slash a bouncer outside off over point but makes no contact
slices the length ball outside off in the air but past the left of point
squared up as he looks to defend a full length delivery that is shaping away from him on leg stump. Defends to mid-off
back of a length and outside off, swings it out to deep square leg

easy as that. Even full length deliveries are not behaving like the batter is expecting. Iyer sees the chance to flick one off his pads for four, but all he manages to do is end up spooning a catch to mid-on. Definite signs of a two-paced pitch
another back of a length slower ball. This seems like a plan. They've seen this pitch might not be easy to hit through the line. They know KKR love hitting through the line. So they're trapping them
tight line on middle, Iyer is able to nudge it off his pads to deep square leg
glides it to the boundary at deep third. Width on offer and Iyer is alert enough to just use the on-pace delivery to his advantage, just opening the face on impact with a defensive push

taken at cover. A shift in line works. And the pitch lends a hand as well. Thushara invites it to by bowling a slightly slower ball into the wicket. Raghuvanshi sees the length and immediately thinks its hittable but he doesn't account for the ball coming off the pitch so slowly and he's through with the shot too soon. Ends up popping a simple catch
sweet strike again. That slingy action can sometimes result in the radar going wrong and once again Thushara bowls too leg side. Raghuvanshi's pick up shot over backward square leg is perfect
bouncer on leg stump, and Narine wears it on the back of his head. Almost looks like he was into the shot too early?
angles it across Narine and he loves the room on offer. Looks to swipe it over the top down the ground. No contact.
another inside edge. This one is a back of a length ball and Raghuvanshi is into the slap through cover too early. Might have been a cross-seam delivery. Ends up a single to deep fine
full and outside off, drives to mid-off

another yorker outside off, this time Narine is expecting it, he crouches down with it and slices it to point and runs. It's a tight run. Dhir might be the one in the infield this time and he almost effects a run-out. Direct hit at the batter's end and it would have been gone

nearly drags it onto his stumps. Bumrah starts with a yorker first up because he knows how important it is to get Narine out early. The batter doesn't move his feet. Just reaches out with his hands and an angled face and is lucky the inside edge only clatters into his pads

lifts it over midwicket. Easy pickings when you bowl on the pads on a ground with such small boundaries. Might not have been a half-volley but not too far from it either. Smooth weight transfer into the ball and outstanding wrists from Raghuvanshi
beats him on the outside edge. Thushara's been searching for movement with the new ball and its there.
down the leg side again, Raghuvanshi tries to glance it away but can't reach it

straight up and there's a collision and they still take the catch!. Once again the ball into the wicket holds up. Thushara is also able to get it to nip away off the pitch. Salt, seeing the length short, tries to access the midwicket boundary. But ends up with leading edge that soars up into the night sky. Tilak is running back from point. The sweeper, Dhir, I think, is running in from the boundary, neither of them are pulling out and in the end and Tilak somehow keeps his concentration and takes the catch
down the leg side. Salt attempts to reach it but cant
smashes it down the ground. This time his timing's there. He sees the ball pitched up, presses forward and nails the drive to the right of mid-off
cramping him on leg stump, maybe even outside it. The left-hander looks to pick it up and lift it over midwicket. Doesn't connect. Might even have stayed a touch lower than the batter expected
uppish, but its wide of cover point. Salt pushing out in front of his body to try and drive on the up. The back of a length ball holds in the pitch and doesn't come on like he wants it to

the middle stump is flattened! Starc erupts in joy, as he cleans the tail up. This is not a full toss, though, and is all but the perfect delivery for a tailender. Coetzee's front leg is out of the way, as he attempts to whack this yorker on middle but is completely beaten. KKR beat MI at Wankhede after 12 years
ahh, an inswinging yorker on from around the wicket. Bumrah jams hit bat, and gets it on the bounce towards the keeper

chipped to extra cover! This came off the toe end of the bat. A low, dipping full toss on fifth stump, as Chawla looked to chip it over. But the length was too full for that shot, and Narine accepted a simple catch. Starc on a hat-trick

taken at long-off! KKR hit back each time MI threaten to make a match out of it. David and the MI camp are stung, as the former pumps a full toss right into Shreyas' hands. KKR know it is a bonus wicket, but will take it, as it gets rid of a big-hitter at this crucial stage
swiped over fine leg! David is across his stumps quite early, and clubs this length ball around off by going across the line. He is deep in the crease too, and starts the over with a six
ahh, this is a yorker-length ball just outside off. Coetzee has a hoick, but is beaten
crunches this pull! Coetzee lets one go. Short of a length around fifth stump, as he lets that bounce nicely before swinging to go over deep midwicket
half-flashes at this shortish ball which is a bit wide of off, and the ball leaps towards deep backward point
goes pulling at this short ball just outside off, and plays on the bounce to deep midwicket. Salt is not able to gather the throw as the ball keeps low, and that allows another run

Russell is pleading with the umpire for a potential lbw call, but it is turned down. And Shreyas reviews. The first replay shows this was heading down. On a short of a length from Russell, and angling in to finish on leg. David went pulling with his back leg just outside leg, and the ball hit his pads and trickled behind the wicket
half an appeal for lbw by Russell, but that seemed to be outside off. David went clipping but got a leading edge towards point
great over for KKR. Starc bowled short and wide of off, as Coetzee went slashing but missed. Just three runs came off this over
quite full, and just outside off. Driven to extra cover for another dot
on a length around fifth stump, and swiped to deep midwicket
short of a length, and angling in towards middle and off. He looks to swipe, but the ball doesn't bounce as much and he is hit on his body
full length, and a bit wide of off. Driven away from his body, but well wide of long-off
on a length, and angling in towards fifth stump. Dabbed towards point
much fuller length, and just outside off. Driven to long-off

another leading edge, but this time he is safe. And they pinch two to leave Shreyas further frustrated. He went to nudge this short-of-a-length ball on fifth stump, but closed the face of the bat early, as the ball popped up towards cover, from where there was an overthrow
slower ball, and full on middle. Tucked towards midwicket

taken by Salt after ending up halfway back to fine leg! In fact, Salt and the fine leg fielder nearly collided, with the latter moving away last moment. The ball was dropping over Salt's right shoulder, and he did well to keep his eyes on it. Russell bowled a full toss at a comfortable, lowish height on the stumps, as Surya swung and sent it miles up. I think that allowed Salt time to move back and nab it
ahh, gets across early, and Russell fires a yorker on middle and off. Gets a leading edge to cover
short of a length on off, and he gets across to punch to deep midwicket
fuller, and much slower on off. Tucked behind point
on a length, and a slightly wide of off. Punched to deep extra cover for two more
full ball angled into off, and punched to long-off
short of a length, and a bit wide of off. Slashed to beat point to his right, but Starc from deep point saves it to his left
tossed up, and dipping on a very full length on a wide line. Heaved to cover
ohh, outside edge, and four! Some luck goes MI's way. David went driving at this full ball around fifth stump, but the mistimed shot still gave him four
same shot, same place, and same result! Arora went short again and bowled just outside off, from where Surya fetched it to crash it to the deep-square-leg boundary. That is 20 off the over
hooked between fine leg and deep square leg! Surya is turning the screws, as he reaches fifty. Short delivery outside off, as Surya swivels to ram that in the gap and leave the bowler stunned

the ball flies over deep point! It was another low, dipping full toss, but this seemed to come on leg. Surya stands after backing away, and slices it really late to send it soaring over the boundary. Superb opening of that bat face
a low full toss on off, and driven to cover from deep in the crease. And it's a no-ball
ramped over short third! This ball is shorter than the previous one, but the line is the same - around fifth stump. Surya lets the ball rise close to his head, and jumps in the crease to upper-cut it
slower ball, and on the shorter side of a length around sixth stump. Surya guides it on the bounce to short third
bowls on a short of a length outside off, and it is pulled to deep square leg
paddle sweeps to deep backward square! He rolls his wrists at this full ball on off, and times and places it perfectly in the gap between fine leg and deep midwicket
short of a length on off, and punched straight down the ground for two
fuller length on middle and off, and turning into leg. Nudged to midwicket
length ball dipping on middle, and whipped aerially towards long-on
on a length on off, and punched back to the bowler
clips this aerially to play wide of long-on, as Venkatesh ran and tumbled to his right to try and pull it back. Surya leaned forward at this full ball on off, and went attacking across the line
another yorker, and this is just outside off. Drilled to long-on
ahh, a dipping yorker on middle at 138kph. Surya clips from deep in the crease to deep square, where the fielder at deep backward square dives to pull it back
a swing-swipe Surya style! The ball goes booming, touches the Sky and lands beyond fine leg. He gets across early, and goes heaving across the line at this fullish ball around off
on a length on middle, as he gets across and clips this to the keeper's left

bowls a bouncer on middle, as David ducks, and the umpire calls it wide. Shreyas reviews it quite late. Russell jammed it in quite short just outside off, and replays indicate that David only had to half-duck as the ball zoomed over his head. The ball is deemed to be too high, and it stays wide

chipped for a catch for midwicket! Pandya falls early again, as MI go deeper into the hole. The slowness of the pitch came into the picture there, as he closed the face of the bat to try and clip, but seemed to have done so quite early. The bat was more horizontal, though, as the ball popped up off the top edge to midwicket's left, as Russell had bowled on a short of a length on leg
short of a length just outside off, and punched to cover with a leap in the crease
quite full and angled into off. Driven to long-off

chopped on! Salt is delighted with that result, even as Narine is barely moved. Narine went on the shorter side of a length around fifth stump, as this one went with the angle from over the wicket. The ball didn't move off the pitch, though, as Wadhera went slapping but ended up smashing his off stump
goes full again, but this is well outside leg. Wadhera looked to sweep but missed, and it's called wide
full and flatter on off. Driven to cover
on a length just outside off, and whipped to deep midwicket
on a length on leg, and turning away. Clipped towards long-on, as Suryakumar turns down the offer for a second
bowls full, and angles this across towards off. Blocked down as he leans forward
another slower ball, and this is short of a length just outside off. Dabbed down for a quick single, even as Russell is down on the pitch
ahh, now a yorker at 138kph. Angles this across and bowls on fifth stump, as Wadhera jams it back to the bowler

now goes for the bouncer... and it is called wide! But Shreyas reviews. Russell went short on leg, and Wadhera went to hook. The ball rook off from the pitch, and went over his bat as he missed his attempted hook. It isn't way too high, though, and below his head. So it is overturned
a slower short ball at 117kph, as he bangs it in on middle, and Wadhera sways out of the way
ahh, Rinku at deep point overruns to his right, and misses the ball! Short of a length from Russell on fifth stump, and Wadhera hacked it hard to play towards deep backward point
short of a length just outside off, and punched to deep midwicket
short of a length, and turning in to end very close to off. Slashed to short third as he played late
on a fullish length on off, and blocked towards square leg off the inside half of the bat

spooned to short third! This went off the top edge, as Varma went driving with a horizontal bat at this fullish ball which is wide of off. Varun got it to dip, and slowed it down, with Varma playing early and letting it pop up for a simple catch for Narine
full and dipping on middle and off, and clipped to deep midwicket. Rinku fumbled, but they were pushing for two anyway
on a length on middle and leg, and finishing outside leg as it goes on with the arm. Nudged to deep square
hacked to deep backward point! Short and wide outside off from Varun, as Suryakumar reaches out to flash it away from his body for four
short of a length, and turning in a bit towards leg. Punched to long-on to keep ticking
full ball dipping on off at 101kph, and pushed to long-off
quite full, and angling across towards fifth stump. He went flashing, but got a bottom edge on to his pad
on a length on off, and pushed to long-on
gets across early, and paddle sweeps this full ball on middle and off to beat short fine leg to his leg. Arora rushes in from fine leg and dives to his right to keep it to two
he goes back in the crease, and clips this full ball on middle to play behind square
short of a length on off, and punched to long-on from deep in the crease
full and flatter on off, and tucked to cover for another dot
fuller ball on middle, and turned to midwicket
ohh, nearly a return catch for Varun! He bowled slower, and went on a length on off. Suryakumar pushed back low to Varun's right, as the bowler bent but couldn't get there
tosses it up, and bowls a low full toss just outside off. Driven to long-off
short of a length on middle and off, and punched to long-on
almost clipped to the man at midwicket! The ball seemed to turn away off a fullish length, and finish outside off, as Varma played early

taken by midwicket moving back! He tried the sweep last ball but mistimed it, and this time fails to time and place the pull. Narine shortened his length a good deal to go short around off, and Rohit pulled with his front leg out of the way. But the ball ballooned up to midwicket's right, with the fielder moving back and across to gobble that
looks to sweep this full and flatter ball on off, but gets it off the bottom off the bat to short fine leg
slows it down, and goes fuller on off. Turned towards square leg
this turns in off a length, and ends on his pads. Clipped to deep square
punched to deep point! Short of a length on fifth stump, and Surya plays after shifting his weight backwards, beating a diving cover-point to his right
fuller side of a length on middle, and he goes back in the crease to punch to long-on
pushes at this full ball finishing around fifth stump, as the ball goes to cover
very full on off, and driven wide of mid-off for a quick single
slower, and much fuller on middle. Pushed towards midwicket
nudges this length ball turning into middle and leg for a single to fine leg

cleaned up first ball! Dhir was again looking to be adventurous, and this time was bowled in looking to swing across the line. He even seemed off balance, as he played from middle stump to a length ball which was bowled from back of the hand on middle and off. It turned in and hit middle, as Dhir played early and missed
on a length on leg, and swiped to deep square leg
a dipping, low full toss, which is angling across towards off. Pushed to extra cover
very full, and around sixth stump. Dhir jams that to extra cover, from where the throw from Shreyas is wide at the non-striker's end, and thus allows an overthrow
ah, a nice follow up from Starc. He bowls an inswinging yorker on leg, as Rohit clips this off his toes to fine leg

superb shot! He just goes through the line, and presents the full face of the bat to loft over cover. There is no foot movement, though, as he uses the pace of the ball, which is on a length, and lands wide of off
pushes at this length ball angling across and finishing towards off, as the ball rolls to cover

another wide down the leg side from Starc, and this time Salt is beaten too. Angles this in from over the wicket, and goes full and wide of leg. Rohit went to clip, but it was too wide, as even the keeper's dive to his left couldn't save a few
pulled to deep midwicket! With the swinging so much, I'm not sure why Arora switched to a short of a length. He banged this in around off, and Dhir swivelled to club this in front of square
again looks to walk down, but the excessive swing back in restricts him. The ball hits his front pad as he looks to flick, with the ball ending on leg
this time he finds the gap between fine leg and deep square leg! Full length and shaping back into middle, as Dhir plays late to pierce the two fielders
much fuller length, and swinging in considerably again. Dhir walks down and attempts to hoick across the line, but gets an inside edge on to his pad, as he plays from middle stump
short of a length just outside off, and angling in to finish closer to off. Dabbed down from deep in the crease
flicks this off the middle stump, as this full ball shapes back in sharply. Single to deep square leg

wow, Salt is celebrating for a potential caught behind! But Starc isn't interested, and Iyer doesn't review. Starc bowled full and just outside leg, as Dhir looked to flick but the ball went into the keeper's hands. It is not called a wide either, so I'm sure the umpire thought that the ball brushed Dhir's pad
gets a lowish full toss which is angling across and coming on at middle and off. Nudged towards mid-on

gone, the leg stump is flattened! And Starc hardly even reacts, even as this was quicker at 142kph. Starc went fuller than the previous ball, angling it into leg again. Kishan swung his bat to go through the line, but this time was beaten. I think the ball skidded through rather quickly too, with Kishan getting completely beaten

clipped over deep backward square leg! Starc again angles this in, but this one lands right on Kishan's pads. This is on the shorter side of a length on leg, and Kishan plays late and uses the pace on the ball to dispatch it
flung over extra cover! He reaches out for this length ball which is wide of off, and rams it over the in-field for four

half an appeal for lbw, but that seemed to be going down the leg side. Angles this in from over the wicket, and goes on a length on middle and leg. It skidded through, as Kishan looked to clip but missed
leans forward into this push off the outside half of the bat to deep third, as the ball is on a length and in the corridor outside off
goes for the heave across the line, and gets it off the inside half of the bat, as the ball is full and angling into a fourth-stump line
well bowled. Goes wide of the crease, and angles this in on a good length on off, as this swings in nicely. Rohit pushes forward from middle and off
fullish length, and angling across towards middle and off. Driven to a wide deep third fielder
dabs this close to off, and the ball trickles from beside leg stump. Not entirely in control there, as this length ball swung into middle and off
swings this into the right-hander, and this lands full and outside leg. Rohit went to flick, but it was wide of leg
bowls full on his pads first ball, and Kishan flicks to square leg. There is a misfield there, and MI get the single
